name: @oes/meilong-ceramics-site
description: Meilong Ceramics production-shaped local site pilot for OES Site Runtime and Nuxt storefront.

scripts.dev: node -e "console.log('Start Meilong locally with two terminals: pnpm dev:backend and pnpm dev:frontend. From the repo root, use pnpm meilong. Use docker compose for the nginx local-domain edge.')"
scripts.test:acceptance:locale-governance: pnpm --dir ../../.. proto:gen && pnpm --dir ../../services/system/site-service prisma:generate && pnpm --dir ../../.. --filter @oes/common clear:build && pnpm --dir ../../.. --filter @oes/common build && pnpm --dir ../../.. --filter site-service clear:build && pnpm --dir ../../.. --filter site-service build && pnpm --dir ../../.. --filter api-gateway clear:build && pnpm --dir ../../.. --filter api-gateway build && pnpm exec tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.acceptance.json && TS_NODE_PROJECT=tsconfig.acceptance.json TS_NODE_TRANSPILE_ONLY=false node --test --require ts-node/register --require tsconfig-paths/register tests/locale-governance-acceptance-harness.test.ts && TS_NODE_PROJECT=tsconfig.acceptance.json TS_NODE_TRANSPILE_ONLY=false node --require ts-node/register --require tsconfig-paths/register scripts/verify-locale-governance-acceptance.ts
scripts.verify: pnpm test:governance && pnpm verify:boundaries && pnpm typecheck && pnpm build && pnpm test:display
scripts.clean:generated: node -e "console.log('Generated directories are ignored but not deleted by default. Review README.md before removing runtime/dist, storefront/.nuxt, storefront/.output, or runtime/data manually.')"
